bascheduler__comment: BAScheduler texts. To translate: copy this file to <language>.json (the game's language codes: en, de, fr, hu, pl, ...), translate the values, keep the keys and the {placeholders} exactly as they are. A missing key falls back to English. The planner's explanation lines and the schedule check messages are keys too (bascheduler_x_*, bascheduler_v_*); their {placeholders} are filled with names, numbers, days and shifts.
bascheduler_options_header: BAScheduler - Schedule, Staff & Opening Hours Planner
bascheduler_status_on_load: Check every schedule when a save is loaded (fast, no solver)
bascheduler_log_game_data: Also write raw business data to the log
bascheduler_require_hr: Apply needs a working HR manager (like the game's auto-fill)
bascheduler_low_cpu: Low CPU mode (2 solver threads; gentler on laptops, slower on big businesses)
bascheduler_full_time_only: Recommend full-time hires only (part-timers only when full-timers cannot fit)
bascheduler_hire_from_planner: Hire button in the planner (cheat: skips the phone and the salary negotiation)
bascheduler_hide_app_button: Hide the Planner button in the menu's app bar (the planner hotkey, F9 by default, and the BizMan card button still open it)
bascheduler_open_window: Open the planner window (hotkey: see its Settings)
bascheduler_dump_ui: Write game UI structure to the log (development)
bascheduler_dev_crowd_bar: Add 6 test buttons to the menu's app bar and log its geometry (development; until the game is restarted)
bascheduler_dev_show_thanks: Show the thank-you message now (developer test; the once-only flag is not touched)
bascheduler_dev_make_ghost: Make a ghost shift (developer test): one existing shift gets a workstation id that does not exist, so the save check and Remove ghost shifts can be tried
bascheduler_thanks_message: Thanks for using BAScheduler - that was your 10th calculation! If it saves you time, a thumbs up on its Workshop page helps other players find it. You will not see this message again.
bascheduler_recalc_confirm_body: {businessName} already has a plan calculated at {time} and nothing has changed since (opening hours, workstations, employees, demands). Calculate again anyway? The previous plan is replaced.
bascheduler_apply_confirm_body: Replace the whole weekly schedule of {businessName} with the calculated one? The current schedule is backed up and can be restored with "Undo last apply".
bascheduler_apply_confirm_body_already_o: The current schedule of {businessName} is already complete and valid. Replace it anyway? It is backed up and can be restored with "Undo last apply".
bascheduler_apply_confirm_body_partial: Apply the calculated schedule to {businessName}? {gaps} seat-hour(s) will stay UNCOVERED until you hire {hires} and recalculate. The current schedule is backed up and can be restored with "Undo last apply".
bascheduler_apply_week_warning: Mid-week: {count} of your people already worked this week on the old schedule and would go over their weekly maximum with the new one ({example}). The game then shows their hour demand as unmet, and they get unhappy until the week resets.
bascheduler_apply_week_warning_batch: Mid-week: in {names}, people who already worked this week on the old schedule would go over their weekly maximum with the new one. The game then shows their hour demand as unmet, and they get unhappy until the week resets.
bascheduler_apply_week_example: {name}: {worked} h worked + {ahead} h still this week, {max} h max
bascheduler_apply_week_advice: Advice: press Apply next Monday, so everyone starts the new schedule with a fresh week (the game resets the weekly hours at midnight going into Monday). No need to calculate again before then: if nothing changes, the planned schedule stays.
bascheduler_undo_confirm_body: Restore the schedule that was backed up before the last apply? The schedule applied by BAScheduler will be replaced.
bascheduler_hire_confirm_body:
Hire these {count} candidate(s) from your My Employees list for {businessName}, at their asking wage, and calculate the schedule again with them?

{list}
bascheduler_hire_confirm_body_step:
The plan for {businessName} needs {total} more people. Hire these {count} first, from your My Employees list at their asking wage? The schedule is calculated again with them right away (a few minutes on a business this size) and then asks only for what is still missing - press Hire again for those.

{list}
bascheduler_hire_list_more: ... and {count} more (the full list is in the log)
bascheduler_about_text: BAScheduler {version} Schedule, staff and opening hours planner: for each business it computes how many employees are needed and which part-time or full-time hires to make, builds a complete weekly schedule that respects every employee's demands, and can apply it to the game with a backup and undo. The Opening hours tab shows how busy every hour is for the business type (the game's own customer-demand data) and suggests demand-based opening hours, which it can apply the same safe way. Works with the game's own data and its own solver; official Mod API only. Bugs and ideas: the pinned discussions on the Workshop page.
bascheduler_win_title: BAScheduler - Schedule, Staff & Opening Hours Planner
bascheduler_win_select_hint: Select a business to see its plan.
bascheduler_win_footer: {count} business(es). Hotkey: {hotkey}. Drag the window by its title bar. Click a row for details.
bascheduler_win_footer_tab: {count} business(es). Hotkey: {hotkey}. Click a row for details.
bascheduler_set_status_on_load: Check every schedule when a save is loaded
bascheduler_set_require_hr: Apply needs a working HR manager
bascheduler_set_require_hr_hint: ON = the game's rule (its auto-fill needs one too). OFF = cheat: schedules are written without an HR manager.
bascheduler_set_hire_from_planner_hint: OFF = hire the game's way. ON = cheat: one click hires the recommended staff from your My Employees candidate list, at their asking wage, skipping the phone and the salary negotiation. Candidates you are negotiating with are left alone.
bascheduler_set_low_cpu_hint: Two solver threads instead of half the cores: gentler on laptops and older machines, slower on big businesses; same answers.
bascheduler_set_full_time_only_hint: New hires are planned as full-timers (30-50 h), taking hours from the current staff if needed. Part-timers are shown only when the missing hours are too few for a full-timer, and the plan says so.
bascheduler_set_hotkey: Window hotkey (click, then press a key)
bascheduler_set_hide_app_button: Hide the app button in the menu bar
bascheduler_set_hide_app_button_hint: For a crowded app bar (many mods): the Planner takes no room there. {hotkey} and the green button on the BizMan business card still open the Planner tab. Switched on by itself when the Planner button ended up under the money and date labels.
bascheduler_set_dev_options: Show developer options in Options → Mods
bascheduler_set_dev_workers: Developer: solver threads for this session
bascheduler_set_dev_workers_hint: A test aid: run the solver as if the machine had this many threads (the time limits stretch to match). Not saved; back to automatic at the next start.
bascheduler_set_clear_cache: Forget every calculated plan of this save
bascheduler_set_clear_cache_hint: The game's schedules stay as they are; the next Calculate of each business starts from scratch (no warm start).
bascheduler_set_ghost_shifts_hint: A shift whose workstation was deleted or moved can stay in the schedule unseen and count as worked hours every hour (a game bug; staff end up with hundreds of hours a week and quit). This button calls the game's own repair for it and forces it to run now, in every building you rent, the headquarters included - the game itself runs it only when it deletes an object. The worked-hours counter is the game's and clears on Monday.
bascheduler_set_copy_report_hint: A short report of the last Calculate (result, explanations, build and solver info) goes to the clipboard - paste it into the Bug reports thread on the Workshop.
bascheduler_set_open_folder_hint: Opens the folder that holds Player.log, the game's log with the mod's reports - attach that file to a bug report. The mod's own data (cache, backups) is in ModsLocal/BAScheduler.Config in the same folder.
bascheduler_msg_report_copied: report copied to the clipboard ({lines} lines); paste it into the Bug reports thread.
bascheduler_msg_ghost_shifts_none: no ghost shifts found in any of your buildings.
bascheduler_msg_ghost_shifts_removed: {count} ghost shift(s) removed ({businesses}); the worked-hours counters clear on Monday.
bascheduler_msg_ghost_shifts_failed: could not remove ghost shifts; see the log.
bascheduler_plan_gap: {hours} seat-hour(s) left open (too few for a full-timer)
bascheduler_sum_need_gap: no full-timer fits; {hours} h/week left open.
bascheduler_set_reload_locales_hint: Re-reads the Locales folder of every mod without a restart, for editing a translation while the game runs. Game language: {language}.
bascheduler_msg_cache_cleared: plan cache cleared: {count} cached plan(s) forgotten; the next calculation of each business starts from scratch.
bascheduler_msg_wait_running: Wait for the running calculation to finish.
bascheduler_msg_needs_hr: Applying a schedule needs a working HR manager, like the game's own auto-fill. Hire one at your headquarters (or turn this rule off in the planner's Settings).
bascheduler_msg_no_plan: {businessName}: no calculation for the current setup - run Calculate first.
bascheduler_msg_applied_partial: schedule applied ({shifts} shifts); {gaps} seat-hour(s) uncovered until you hire {hires}, then recalculate
bascheduler_msg_apply_failed: Apply failed: {error} - use Undo to restore the backup.
bascheduler_msg_nothing_to_undo: Nothing to undo: no backup found for this save.
bascheduler_msg_undo_gone: Cannot undo: {businessName} is no longer one of your businesses.
bascheduler_msg_batch: Calculated {count} businesses: {parts}. Details in the planner window.
bascheduler_msg_hire_disabled: The hire button is switched off (Settings, Rules and cheats).
bascheduler_msg_hire_none_needed: {businessName}: the current plan recommends no hires.
bascheduler_msg_hire_no_candidates: {businessName}: nobody on your My Employees candidate list fits {missing}. Check the job board or a headhunter.
bascheduler_msg_hired: hired {count}: {names}; calculating the schedule with them now
bascheduler_msg_no_target: Open a business in BizMan (or stand inside one of your businesses) first.
bascheduler_msg_target_not_schedulable: {businessName} ({reason}) cannot be scheduled by BAScheduler (headquarters, warehouse or no business).
bascheduler_plan_not_calculated: not calculated yet for the current setup
bascheduler_plan_stale: the setup changed since the plan of {time} - calculate again
bascheduler_plan_blocker_inconclusive: the last calculation did not finish in time; recalculate with a higher time limit
bascheduler_plan_blocker_infeasible: the business cannot be fully covered with the current staff and workstations
bascheduler_plan_blocker_kept_invalid: the current shifts break rules the plan would have to keep (see the details)
bascheduler_plan_kept_invalid: the current shifts break {count} rule(s) the plan would have to keep - fix them, or switch this business to Full plan
bascheduler_plan_blocker_invalid: the calculated schedule did not pass validation
bascheduler_plan_inconclusive: calculation did not finish in time - calculate again
bascheduler_plan_hire_applicable: (can be applied now with {hours} seat-hour(s) uncovered)
bascheduler_sum_need_none_yet: not calculated yet for the current setup - press Calculate.
bascheduler_sum_need_unknown: unknown - the calculation ran out of time.
bascheduler_sum_raise_limit: Calculate again; a step that finds nothing gets up to 60 s.
bascheduler_sum_retry: Calculate again; a tight staff makes this a hard puzzle.
bascheduler_sum_need_impossible: cannot be fully covered with the current staff and workstations.
bascheduler_sum_need_kept_invalid: the current shifts break {count} rule(s) a plan around them would have to keep. Fix them by hand, or switch this business to Full plan, then calculate again.
bascheduler_sum_hire_step: The week needs {total} more people. Hire about {first} first, then Calculate again: the plan then works with your real people and their demands, and asks only for what is still missing. The Hire button does exactly this.
bascheduler_sum_hire_totals: {total}h/week of new hires in total ({fulltime}h full-time, {parttime}h part-time).
bascheduler_sum_hire_totals_note: Shift patterns of the individual hires are not listed for this many; hire them, then Calculate again for their real schedule.
bascheduler_sum_limit_note: (time limit reached; a longer limit may find more)
bascheduler_sum_not_needed_nobody: nobody - every employee is required to cover the week.
bascheduler_sum_not_needed_some: {count} of {total} - the other {rest} still cover the week.
bascheduler_sum_not_needed_parts_spare: not checked for a business this large, but the hours alone need at least {floor} people: up to {spare} of your {total} may be spare.
bascheduler_sum_not_needed_parts_none: not checked for a business this large, but the hours alone need at least {floor} people and you have {total}: nobody is spare.
bascheduler_sum_not_needed_parts_info: Days off and hour bands can raise that floor. Remove a few, calculate again, and the plan says whether the week still fits.
bascheduler_sum_not_needed_info: Informational only: letting someone go is your call; idle employees quit on their own.
bascheduler_sum_current_ok: OK - every open hour is covered, all requirements met.
bascheduler_sum_unmet_suffix: , but the game reports {count} unmet demand(s)
bascheduler_sum_game_demand_note: This is the game's own check (the warning on the employee). Hour-band demands compare the hours actually worked this week, so after mid-week schedule changes they can show as unmet even when the schedule is fine; they reset with the new week.
bascheduler_sum_plan_partial: can be applied now; {hours} seat-hour(s) stay uncovered until you hire {hires}, then calculate again.
bascheduler_sum_plan_ready: ready to apply - a complete, valid week for the current staff.
bascheduler_sum_plan_additive: Keeps the {shifts} current shift(s) ({hours} h) exactly as they are; only the gaps are filled.
bascheduler_sum_limit_unchanged: (time limit reached; the last recalculation found no plan with fewer hires, so this one was kept).
bascheduler_sum_limit_raise: (time limit reached; a longer limit may need fewer hires).
bascheduler_sum_limit_again: (time limit reached; calculating again may still need fewer hires, never more).
bascheduler_win_mode_hint: Full plan: the planner may replace the whole week of this business. Keep shifts: every shift set now stays exactly as it is (person, day, hours, workstation); the plan only fills the gaps - by lengthening a shift on its day, new shifts on free days, and hires. Set per business, so Calculate all respects it. Shifts that break a rule (overstaffing, a banned period, too many hours) are reported instead of replanned.
bascheduler_progress_info: You can close this menu: the calculation continues in the background and the planner shows the result when it is done.
bascheduler_msg_cancelled: Calculation cancelled: the interrupted business keeps its previous plan, the ones already finished keep their new plan.
bascheduler_msg_report_auto_copied: {businessName}: the calculation could not finish in time. A short report is on your clipboard - paste it into the Bug reports thread on the Workshop page so it can be fixed.
bascheduler_msg_batch_report_suffix: A short report of the last inconclusive one is on your clipboard - paste it into the Bug reports thread.
bascheduler_msg_bizman_unavailable: The business page could not be opened (BizMan not available).
bascheduler_msg_bar_full: The app bar is full: the Planner button ended up under the money and date labels (or off screen), so it is hidden and "Hide the app button" is switched on (Settings, Window). {hotkey} and the green button on the BizMan business card open the Planner.
bascheduler_hours_unsupported: Opening hours are planned for shops and other customer-facing businesses only (not for headquarters or warehouses).
bascheduler_hours_no_data: The game has no customer-demand data for this business type, so there is nothing to suggest. You can still set the hours by hand on the grid and apply them.
bascheduler_hours_disclaimer: How busy each hour of the week is compared with the busiest hour, for this business type, read from the game's own data. It is relative customer demand only: building traffic, neighbourhood, marketing and satisfaction are not part of it. A demand-based aid for choosing the hours, not a profit forecast.
bascheduler_hours_now: Open now: {hours} h per week, capturing {percent}% of the weekly customer demand.
bascheduler_hours_planned: Planned: {hours} h per week, capturing {percent}% of the weekly customer demand.
bascheduler_hours_threshold_hint: Suggest marks every hour when customer demand is at least this share of the busiest hour of the week. A lower value opens more hours (and needs more staff), a higher value keeps only the busiest hours. Click any hour on the grid to add or remove it by hand.
bascheduler_hours_threshold_text: Suggest opens every hour with at least {value}% of the demand of the busiest hour. Lower: more hours open, more staff needed. Higher: only the busiest hours.
bascheduler_hours_footer: Click an hour to add it to the plan or take it out. Applying the hours does not change the shifts: plan the staff on the Businesses page afterwards.
bascheduler_hours_confirm_body: Set the opening hours of {businessName} to the planned {hours} h per week (now {current} h)? The planned hours capture {percent}% of the weekly customer demand (now {currentPercent}%). The current shifts stay as they are - plan the staff afterwards. The previous hours and shifts are backed up and can be restored with "Undo last apply".
bascheduler_msg_hours_applied: opening hours set: {hours} h per week, capturing {percent}% of the weekly customer demand. Plan the staff for the new hours on the Businesses page.
bascheduler_msg_hours_same: {businessName}: the planned opening hours are the same as the current ones.
bascheduler_hours_draft_is_suggestion: The planned hours are the suggestion at {value}%.
bascheduler_hours_draft_edited: The planned hours were edited by hand or reset to the current ones; Back to suggestion gives the {value}% suggestion again.
bascheduler_hours_draft_copied: The planned hours are the current hours of {name}; Back to suggestion gives the {value}% suggestion again.
bascheduler_apply_selected_confirm_body: Apply the calculated schedules of {count} business(es): {names}?{partial} Every current schedule is backed up; "Undo last apply" restores all of them.{skipped}
bascheduler_apply_selected_partial: {count} of them will stay partly UNCOVERED until you hire the recommended staff and recalculate.
bascheduler_apply_selected_skipped: Skipped (no applicable plan for the current setup): {names}.
bascheduler_msg_apply_selected_none: None of the ticked businesses has an applicable plan for its current setup - run Calculate first.
bascheduler_msg_applied_batch: Applied {count} schedule(s): {names}. "Undo last apply" restores all of them.
bascheduler_undo_confirm_body_batch: Restore the schedules that were backed up before the last apply of {count} business(es) ({names})? The schedules applied by BAScheduler will be replaced.
bascheduler_sum_secondary: {name} covers {seat} with a secondary skill ({skill} {level}%, {hours} h/week).
bascheduler_sum_secondary_note: The game's own schedule editor accepts a secondary skill; the workstation then works at that skill's level. Primary-skilled staff always come first; a secondary seating is used only where it saves a hire or closes a gap.
bascheduler_secondary_skills: Use secondary skills (seat someone by a secondary skill where it saves a hire)
bascheduler_set_secondary_skills_hint: After the normal plan, one more solver step tries to replace recommended hires with your own people sitting on a workstation of their secondary skill (the game's schedule editor accepts that; the station then works at that skill's level). Primary-skilled staff always come first, and the plan names every such seating. Off: primary skills only, no extra step.
bascheduler_v_conflicting_requirements: {name} has both a four-day and a five-day work week requirement.
bascheduler_v_coverage_gap: Coverage gap: {seat} on {day} {from}-{to} has nobody assigned.
bascheduler_v_overstaffed: {seat} on {day} {from}-{to}: {count} people assigned, exactly 1 allowed (no overlap).
bascheduler_v_shift_too_short: {name} has a {hours}h block on {day} {from}-{to}; minimum is {min}h.
bascheduler_v_split_shift: {name} has {count} separate blocks on {day} but split shifts are disabled.
bascheduler_v_hours_under_min: {name} ({band}) is scheduled for {hours}h, below the minimum of {min}h.
bascheduler_v_hours_over_max: {name} ({band}) is scheduled for {hours}h, above the maximum of {max}h.
bascheduler_v_day_count: {name} must work exactly {required} days but works {days}.
bascheduler_v_restricted_period: {name} ({requirement}) is scheduled {shift}, overlapping the restricted period.
bascheduler_x_keep_shifts: Keep the current shifts: {shifts} shift(s) ({hours} h) of the current schedule stay exactly as they are; the plan only fills what they leave open (a kept shift may be lengthened on the same day). The staff reduction check does not run in this mode.
bascheduler_x_full_time_gap: Full-time hires only: {hours} h/week is left that no full-timer can take (a full-timer works 30-50 h, a seat open longer than 50 h leaves a remainder below 30 h). Your {employees} employee(s) cover at most {capacity} h of the {needed} h needed. Hire a part-timer for them by hand (the game's minimum is 10 h) or one more full-timer, then calculate again: this setting only limits what the planner recommends, everyone you hire is scheduled with their whole hour band - a part-timer brings up to 30 h, not just these, which can make one full-timer spare (the "not needed" line will say so).
bascheduler_x_full_time_gap_ranges: Full-time hires only: {hours} h/week is left that no full-timer can take (a full-timer works 30-50 h, a seat open longer than 50 h leaves a remainder below 30 h). Your {employees} employee(s) cover at most {capacity} h of the {needed} h needed. Left open: {ranges}. Hire a part-timer for them by hand (the game's minimum is 10 h) or one more full-timer, then calculate again: this setting only limits what the planner recommends, everyone you hire is scheduled with their whole hour band - a part-timer brings up to 30 h, not just these, which can make one full-timer spare (the "not needed" line will say so).
bascheduler_x_no_hours: The business has no opening hours; nothing to schedule.
bascheduler_x_kept_invalid: Keep the current shifts: the current schedule breaks {count} rule(s) a plan around it would have to keep, so nothing was calculated. Fix them by hand, or let the planner replace the schedule of this business, and calculate again:
bascheduler_x_limit_raised_max: The first attempt at {start} s per solver step found no schedule; the limit was raised to {limit} s (the maximum).
bascheduler_x_limit_raised_found: The first attempt at {start} s per solver step found no schedule; the limit was raised to {limit} s and the plan below was found with it.
bascheduler_x_warm_better: Warm start: found a better plan than the previous one (previous kept only if nothing better turns up).
bascheduler_x_warm_hint_only: Warm start: the previous plan no longer fits the current setup; it was used as a hint only.
bascheduler_x_warm_newcomers_fallback: A fresh plan with your new people found no schedule within the time limit, so the previous plan is kept as the starting point; the people who joined since may be idle in it. Calculate again to try afresh.
bascheduler_x_warm_newcomers: Warm start skipped: {count} of your people joined after the previous plan was made (its hires stood in for them), so the week was planned afresh with everyone.
bascheduler_x_parts: Planned in {parts} parts because of the size ({seats} workstations, {employees} employees): each part is up to {chunk} interchangeable workstations with their share of the staff, solved on its own; the merged week is valid but may need a few more hires than a joint plan would.
bascheduler_x_part_infeasible: cannot be covered even with hires.
bascheduler_x_hires_total: Hires in total: {count} ({fullTime} full-time, {partTime} part-time); per part: {perPart}.
bascheduler_x_parts_infeasible: No valid schedule: at least one part of the business cannot be covered even with additional hires (see below).
bascheduler_x_parts_timeout: The calculation ran out of time on at least one part of the business. This is NOT proof that staffing is impossible; calculate again (a step that finds nothing gets up to the maximum time, 60 s).
bascheduler_x_warm_parts_kept: Warm start: every part kept its previous plan (nothing better found within the time limit).
bascheduler_x_parts_no_checks: Staff reduction check and why-probes are skipped for a business planned in parts.
bascheduler_x_floor_spare: Who is not needed is not checked in parts. The hours alone need at least {floor} people ({hours} h a week, {max} h each at most); up to {spare} of your {scheduled} may be spare (their days off and hour bands decide): remove a few, calculate again, and the plan will say whether the week still fits.
bascheduler_x_floor_at: Who is not needed is not checked in parts. The hours alone need at least {floor} people ({hours} h a week, {max} h each at most); your {scheduled} are at that floor.
bascheduler_x_no_seat: {name} fits no workstation of this business and stays unassigned.
bascheduler_x_no_seat_profession: {name} ({skill}): this business works with {professions}, the game counts nobody else at its workstations, fits no workstation of this business and stays unassigned.
bascheduler_x_staff_changed: The staff changed since the previous plan, so "not needed" was worked out afresh.
bascheduler_x_reduce_skipped: Staff reduction check skipped: the time budget was used up by the schedule itself; calculate again to get it.
bascheduler_x_reduce_timeout: Staff reduction check did not finish within the time limit; calculate again to get it.
bascheduler_x_not_needed_nobody: Not needed: nobody - every employee is required to cover the week.
bascheduler_x_not_needed_nobody_limit: Not needed: nobody - every employee is required to cover the week (time limit reached; a longer limit may find more).
bascheduler_x_not_needed: Not needed: {count} of {total} - the other {others} still cover the week: {people}. Informational only; idle employees quit on their own.
bascheduler_x_not_needed_limit: Not needed: {count} of {total} - the other {others} still cover the week (time limit reached; a longer limit may find more): {people}. Informational only; idle employees quit on their own.
bascheduler_x_warm_cosmetic: Warm start: a slightly tidier week exists with the same people and hires; the previous plan is kept unchanged so the schedule does not move on every calculation.
bascheduler_x_warm_optimal: Warm start: the previous plan is optimal; kept unchanged.
bascheduler_x_warm_kept: Warm start: no better plan found within the time limit; the previous plan is kept unchanged.
bascheduler_x_timeout: The calculation ran out of time before finding a schedule. This is NOT proof that staffing is impossible - the business is large. Calculate again (every step starts at 10 s and gets up to 60 s when it finds nothing); if it keeps failing, Settings - Maintenance - Copy report and paste it into the Workshop's Bug reports thread.
bascheduler_x_secondary: {name} covers {seat} with a secondary skill ({skill} {level}%): {hours} h/week.
bascheduler_x_minimums_exceed: The roster's combined weekly-hour minimums ({minimums}h) exceed the required coverage ({needed}h), so not everyone can be scheduled. Warning: unassigned employees quit over time in the game.
bascheduler_x_probes_skipped: Why-probes ("could X be scheduled if...") are skipped for a business this large; a longer time limit or a recalculation may still place more people.
bascheduler_x_could_as_is: {name} could be scheduled as-is, but only by leaving a different employee unassigned instead.
bascheduler_x_could_if_removed: {name} could be scheduled if '{requirement}' were removed.
bascheduler_x_infeasible: No valid schedule found: the opening hours cannot be fully covered even with additional hires.
bascheduler_x_hint_short_period: Opening period {day} {from}-{to} is shorter than the {min}-hour minimum shift, so the planner cannot fill it (the game's own auto-fill skips such stretches too): make it at least {min} h, or set that hour by hand and use Keep shifts mode.
bascheduler_x_hint_too_few_hours: Each seat needs only {hours}h/week, below the part-time minimum ({min}h); no employee can be scheduled that little. Extend the opening hours.
bascheduler_x_hint_heads_per_day: A day open longer than {max} h needs {heads} people per workstation per day: {needed} for the {count} {seat} station(s), {capable} of your staff can work them - at least {more} more people (or a shorter day).
bascheduler_about_translation: Translations: English by Shanpapa; each other language by its translator, credited in the change notes and in the Translations discussion on the Workshop page.
